dataset_scope: FlyWire v783 inputs and the Shiu et al. public benchmark

entries.license_or_terms: FlyWire public-release terms; see https://home.flywire.ai/guidelines (CC BY-NC 4.0 for the public release).

entries.role: Analysis-ready connectivity table derived from FlyWire v783
